title: Harden web request helpers: opt-in default credentials
summary: Http Web Request Mgt. and SOAP Web Service Request Mgt. now disable default credentials by default and require callers to opt in with SetUseDefaultCredentials(true) for on-premises installations, preventing unintended transmission of Business Central service account credentials to external hosts.
key_points: Http Web Request Mgt. and SOAP Web Service Request Mgt. no longer use default credentials unless the caller opts in
New OnPrem SetUseDefaultCredentials(Boolean) lets callers turn default credentials back on
Fault-response trace logging in Http Web Request Mgt. is now off by default; use SetTraceLogEnabled(true)
Extension Marketplace never sends default credentials for its AppSource telemetry callback
Library - Graph Mgt test library opts in because API tests call the local BC server
